stations.title: Rider
stations.note: At the Pebble Lane Pantry desk.

stations.title: Pip
stations.note: It only knows what it is told.

captions: At Pebble Lane Pantry, riders keep asking where an order is.
Pip cannot read the order list, so it guesses.
You write the piece in between, in three tasks.
Now your code looks the order up.
Same question, real answer. You build the middle.
